The '''Model-X1 Zhurst''' was a model of [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud car]] used on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] owned a red Model-X1 Zhurst, which he ordered the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to pick up in order to find [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="Zorba" />
